To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
information security strategy implementation is a function of organizational capabilities, and that information security strategy is positively associated with organization performance.
organizational capabilities have a significant impact on information security strategy and that information security strategy has an impact on organization performance.

the organizational capabilities of sense making, asset availability, operations management, and decision-making, in that order, are positively related to information security strategy implementation, which is positively related to organization performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between organizational capabilities and information security strategy and its impact on organization performance.
the role of organizational capabilities in determining the success of information security strategies and the impact on organization performance.
the role of organizational capabilities and its impact on information security strategy implementation, which in turn affects organization performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the organizational capabilities are positively related to organization performance, through the mediation of information security strategy implementation effectiveness.
organizational capabilities are important for the success of information security strategy implementation and the success of information technology strategy implementation.
organizational information security capabilities are critical to the effective implementation of information strategy and to the organization performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

organizational capabilities, including situational awareness, asset availability, decision making, and operations management, have a significant influence on the success of implementing an information security strategy and the performance of the organization.

the organizational capabilities of sense making, asset availability, operations management, and decision making have positive effects on organization performance, but the effect of decision making is not significant.
organizational information security capabilities can be viewed as the key enablers to improve information security strategy and organizational performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the information security strategy is not a one-time activity, but a process that needs to be constantly updated and improved.
organizational capabilities can be leveraged for improving information security strategy implementation, which can in turn improve organization performance.
organizations should focus on building organizational capabilities that are critical to information security strategy implementation, as well as to organization performance.
